blocks.text: Buying a Home in Columbia Valley, near Chilliwack: Local Market & Neighbourhood Guide

parts.t: Columbia Valley

is a key residential search area in the eastern Fraser Valley connected via Columbia Valley Road / Henderson Road south of Cultus Lake and Lindell Beach down to the U.S. border in FVRD Electoral Area H. Buyers comparing active MLS® listings in Columbia Valley will find rural acreages (2 to 40+ acres), hobby farms, equestrian estates, and detached country homes in a quiet valley bowl south of Cultus Lake. For a full breakdown of official community plans, catchment maps, and hazard overlays, read our
Columbia Valley Neighbourhood Guide

blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Columbia Valley

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Columbia Valley are served by Cultus Lake Community School (K–5), Vedder Middle School, and Sardis Secondary School in SD33. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Cultus Lake Provincial Park (Maple Bay, Entrance Bay, Jade Bay), South Beach at Lindell Beach, and the Columbia Valley Community Hall and park grounds. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by seasonal BC Transit Route 56 at Cultus Lake and private vehicle access via Columbia Valley Road north to Vedder Crossing and Sardis.

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Columbia Valley

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Columbia Valley are regulated by the Fraser Valley Regional District (FVRD) Official Community Plan for Electoral Area H, Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) farm regulations, FVRD slope and flood hazard mapping, and private well and septic systems. Before removing subjects on a property in Columbia Valley, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our

and

What types of homes are for sale in Columbia Valley?

Active MLS® listings in Columbia Valley typically include rural acreages (2 to 40+ acres), hobby farms, equestrian estates, and detached country homes in a quiet valley bowl south of Cultus Lake. All listings at the top of this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed.
Which schools serve Columbia Valley in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Columbia Valley include Cultus Lake Community School (K–5), Vedder Middle School, and Sardis Secondary School in SD33. Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Columbia Valley?

Residents of Columbia Valley have access to Cultus Lake Provincial Park (Maple Bay, Entrance Bay, Jade Bay), South Beach at Lindell Beach, and the Columbia Valley Community Hall and park grounds. See our
Columbia Valley Neighbourhood Guide
for detailed park addresses and trail notes.
How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Columbia Valley?

Key road corridors serving Columbia Valley include Columbia Valley Road / Henderson Road south of Cultus Lake and Lindell Beach down to the U.S. border in FVRD Electoral Area H. Public transit connections include seasonal BC Transit Route 56 at Cultus Lake and private vehicle access via Columbia Valley Road north to Vedder Crossing and Sardis.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Columbia Valley?

Properties in Columbia Valley are governed by the Fraser Valley Regional District (FVRD) Official Community Plan for Electoral Area H, Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) farm regulations, FVRD slope and flood hazard mapping, and private well and septic systems. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Columbia Valley freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Columbia Valley are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
